qolFindings.title: On an empty account whose server minimum is above the app, the backup reports 'Backup non raggiungibile' for good instead of an update problem
qolFindings.evidence: startBackup adopts the minimum before connecting, so the device turns read-only; finishRestore then calls stopAwaitingAccountCourse, which the write guard refuses, and the catch set the unreachable error; the awaiting flag stays, also after a relaunch. The read-only banner does show. Nothing is lost.
qolFindings.reproduction: Live, test account 1 cleared, RPC routed to '9.0.0', sign in on an empty device, wait 20 s: state error, meta awaiting=1 and data version 9000000.

qolFindings.title: After a restore, a read-only device keeps the awaiting flag
qolFindings.evidence: stopAwaitingAccountCourse at connection is refused by the read-only guard and swallowed; harmless while the course is present (deviceCourseId gates restoring); cleared at the first connection after the update.
qolFindings.reproduction: Routed 9.0.0 restore; read meta after the reopen.

resolved.SC-B5-1: Fixed: live, RPC routed to 0.5.0 the restore reopens writable (meta 5000/5000, state connected, no pageerror); routed to 9.0.0 it reopens read-only (meta 9000000/9000000).
resolved.SC-B5-2: Fixed: with the first RPC aborted the restore still reopens; the connection after it reads the minimum again and adopts 9.0.0; read-only from the next launch.
resolved.SC-B5-3: Fixed: the spec routes 0.5.0 and 9.0.0 through the real restore; b5-restore-live (3) and b5-restore (4): 7 passed.
resolved.SC-B5-4: Fixed: live, two devices: B on the empty account reopens by itself on A's course; the server holds one course.
resolved.SC-B5-5: Fixed: with the PowerSync host blocked, restoring persists through a reload, 'Esci dall’account' is offered and import disabled; signing in again unblocked restores the course with the matching id.
